bio: Henry Pitts, known as Black Lansky, runs Cumulative Web Inc and manages flagship artist That Boy Hi Hat. As a producer and executive producer he has co-production credits across the CWI catalog: That Boy Hi Hat's catalog including Idol or Icon (with Jeck Da General) and Diabolique (with Hybrid); King Akeem's Next Generation Protocol singles; Greg Porn's Pay Yourself and On Edge; Dre50's Pix (lyricist and assistant producer); and 183 Wildboi's Rock-Rap Revival core tracks Stunt and Full Moon. He owns the rights to the That Boy Hi Hat tracks connected to Jeck Da General and the catalogs he co-produced for the CWI roster.
